title: Baba Ay Mere Baba
body:
baba ay mere baba aao dhal gaya suraj
har taraf hai sannata aao dhal gaya suraj
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf apne seene par shab guzaar lene do
subha phir chale jaana aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono haat phailaye mai tumhe bulaati hoon
ab nahi raha jaata aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend se bhari aakhein tumko yaad karti hai
so'un kis tarha tanha aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam tak sabhi apne ghar ko laut aate hai
raat hogayi baba aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushmano ki basti mein khaufnak sehra mein
be-rida hoon be-saaya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr mere kaano se cheen le gaya gauhar
zulm ho gaya kya kya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas tumhare jaate hi ghar jale chini chadar
hum se phir gayi dunya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tumhe gawara hai mai yateem kehlaun
tum to ho mere baba aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi suroor aksar rauza e sakina par
goonjta hai ye nauha aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
author: Suroor Lakhnavi
